## Design

### 2026-10-07 – Oct 6th (didn't have time to journal):

**2.5h**

Oct 6th (didn't have time to journal):
Did a lot of research into what materials I'll be using to create Megabot while downloading KiCad. As this is my first time creating a PCB, I used Claude for guidance through the entire KiCad download process and to fetch a variety of hardware I could be using and personally researched each one to see how they would all be incorporated into my design. I'll be using an ESP32-C3 for the brain, and be using a 1.28" round display for the face of Megabot! After KiCad finally downloaded on an older computer (my computer has far too little space), I realized the older version of KiCad that I downloaded for that macOS couldn't open the Seeed Xiao library I needed, so I'd have to use a Conn Pin and label it to the ESP32 pinout.

### 2026-10-08 – Today I researched about how PCBs work and what schematics actually do (only prior knowledge I have is I started Macropad PCB designing but never got to finish it) I started working on the schematic b

**3h**

Today I researched about how PCBs work and what schematics actually do (only prior knowledge I have is I started Macropad PCB designing but never got to finish it) I started working on the schematic but had to troubleshoot a lot. It was a painful and painstaking process, I had to find a compatible ESP32-C3 footprint and symbol for my older version of Kicad, as I'm running it on an older MacBook. At first I thought using a Conn-Pin 1x 14, but that was obviously a mistake as the ESP32 has pins on both sides.I finally found compatible .sym file after all the labelling so I redid it. I then used Claude to help troubleshoot and to label the schematic rather than wire them. The schematic is finally over but I have no clue how I will be able to do the rest of the project before the deadline 🤞
